steps.prompt: The bishop moves any number of squares diagonally and cannot jump over pieces.
steps.explanation: The bishop moves any number of squares diagonally and cannot jump over pieces.

steps.prompt: Tap any square the white bishop on d4 can reach.
steps.explanation: From d4 the bishop has four diagonals to slide along.

steps.prompt: Capture the black pawn on f6.
steps.explanation: The pawn on f6 is on the same diagonal as the bishop (d4, e5, f6).
steps.hint: Go up and to the right.

steps.prompt: A bishop starting on a light square can only ever stand on which squares?
steps.explanation: A diagonal step always lands on the same colour, so each bishop is stuck on one colour for the whole game.
From b5 or h5 the bishop sees the black king on e8 along a diagonal.
steps.hint: Find a square on a diagonal that leads to e8.
